mentions.name: ADB-based F-Droid app installer
mentions.description: A lightweight F-Droid-style Android app that uses ADB to download apps directly to the phone, avoiding the lengthy procedures normally needed to install third-party apps. The app is nearly complete and planned for GitHub release; an in-app security layer for downloads is still in development (about two months of work) because the approach bypasses Android's own security.
mentions.problem: Android is stopping third-party apps, making installs subject to lengthy, painful procedures.
mentions.source_excerpt: After seeing that Android is stopping third party apps i decided to make a lightweight F droid app that uses adb to download stuff directly to the phone so you don't need to do all those lengthy procedures and stuff that are a pain.
mentions.author: KinetiNode
